source_line: Source: Statistics Canada, Consumer Price Index, October 2026 (Nov. 16)
caption:
Canada's cost of living isn't cooling.

Inflation held at 3.1% year over year in October — the same as September, still above the Bank of Canada's 2% target, Statistics Canada reported Monday. Groceries actually sped up: 2.0% higher than a year ago, versus 1.7% in September. Slower rent growth kept the headline from rising.

Gas looks alarming at 30.9% year over year, but StatCan says that's mostly a base-year effect — pump prices fell 2.5% from September.

My take: a flat number hides the part that hits the till. Food is re-accelerating while the relief is in rent.
